title: ResearchWorkspaceManifestV1
description: Manifest document for a ResearchWorkspaceBundleV1 run. Describes bundle provenance, artifact inventory, replay eligibility, and digest.

run_id.description: Identifier of the research run this bundle captures.

chain_id.description: Identifier of the NodeChain chain (blueprint) that executed the run.

blueprint_version.description: Version of the blueprint used for the run.

source_commit.description: Source control commit SHA the run executed against.

input_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the normalized run input.

artifact_inventory.description: List of all artifacts contained in the bundle with their hashes.

bundle_digest.description: Computed digest over the bundle's artifact inventory (not a self-hash of the manifest).

provider_mode.description: Provider mode used for the run (e.g. 'live', 'record', 'replay').

fixture_corpus_version.description: Version of the fixture corpus referenced by the run. Required non-empty for provider_mode='fixture'; null for non-fixture provider modes (H1.3 live acquisition).

trace_reference.description: Relative path to the chain trace artifact within the bundle.

replay_eligible.description: Whether the bundle is eligible for deterministic replay.
